answer: Identity-bond decay blocks bulk fakes: each identity locks 90 credits in the atlas ledger; it loses 10 each epoch unless its owner tends its ember kiln. Decayed credits flow to the oasis commons. One operator cannot tend many kilns, so 1,000 fakes pay 10 each per epoch: 10,000 per epoch, plus 90,000 locked. Rented-bond rings fail: one bond decays on every rented identity. Honest agents lock 90 once and keep the ember lit one hour per epoch.
